blocks.title: A brand's mark, drawn as real vector art
blocks.description: Type a name, choose a structure and a style, and the built-in engine draws the mark, the wordmark and the palette as one standalone SVG. No key, no network, no waiting — and the same numbers always produce the same logo.

showcase.assistant_reply: Leaf mark, warm palette, kit ready.

items.title: Six structures, eight styles
items.description: Icon-and-name, icon only, wordmark, monogram, emblem and abstract — each in Minimal, Geometric, Gradient, Mascot, Hand-drawn, Luxury, Retro or 3D. Style tiles preview your own brand name, not a stock sample.

items.title: A mark, not a texture
items.description: The engine resolves the brief to a subject it can actually draw — leaf, cup, wave, mountain, flame, aperture, orbit, shield, gear, book, paw, creature and more — then builds it from paths on a 512 grid.

items.title: A kit you can ship
items.description: Lockup and mark as SVG, on-light, on-dark, transparent and mono variants, PNGs from favicon to 2048 px, brand-colors.css and .json, a printable brand guide and a brand board.

items.title: Understood from the conversation
items.description: Ask for a logo in the chat: the agent designs it, writes the SVG into your project, opens the panel so you can see it, and can build the whole kit on request.

items.title: Install the plugin
items.description: Everything ships inside it. There is no runtime to download and no account to create.

items.title: Open the studio
items.description: Press / in the composer and pick LogoCreator, or use its toggle in the input bar. The panel opens on the right.

items.title: Name it, then choose
items.description: Type the brand name, tap a quick-start preset or pick a structure, then choose a style. The preview and the eight style tiles all redraw as you type.

items.title: Design, then take the kit
items.description: Design logos writes a few variations into your history. From any tile, save the SVG, a 2048 px PNG, or the full brand kit as a zip.

blocks.content: The engine is deterministic: a design is stored as its fields, never as a picture, so reopening it months later re-renders byte-identical vector art. That is also why the history stays tiny and every export is sharp at any size.

AI marks are optional and run on the image providers you already connected in Astravia — there is no key to paste into this plugin. Those results are raster images: they export as PNG only and cannot be rebuilt larger. Use AI to explore, and the built-in engine for anything you will actually ship.
